notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch via curl with a browser UA, one request at a time with delays to avoid the site's rate limiter which returned 429 on rapid bursts) was sufficient throughout - no Playwright/Chrome escalation needed. robots.txt checked first: no Claude-specific disallow (no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot rule), so not policy_opt_out; robots.txt also lists the seo-*-index.xml sitemaps used below. Discovered the full seasonal taxonomy via the top-level 'seo-category-sitemap' (79 cat URLs) which contains exactly one seasonal root: /holiday/cat/holiday-c1877112.html ('Modern Holiday', title-confirmed, breadcrumb root 'Holiday') plus /holiday/cat/holiday-sale-c1877113.html. The 'seo-sb0-sitemap' (281 URLs, 2nd-tier PLPs) confirmed exactly 10 children of the Holiday node, all breadcrumbed 'Holiday > <name>': Christmas Trees (313), Christmas Stockings + Holders (59), Ornaments + Tree Decor (206), Tree Skirts + Collars (26), Tree + Novelty Garlands (20), Garlands + Swag (151), Wreaths (170), Holiday Lighting (64), Holiday Accents + Decor (201), Judaica (40) - each qty is the site's own rendered 'N Items' PLP header. Sum of the 10 children = 1,250, which matches the parent Holiday hub's own header of 1,255 Items (negligible live-inventory variance) - confirming the parent is a true aggregate/superset, so it was kept as a grouping row only (qty null) and NOT summed/double-counted against its children, per the grouping-row rule. AllModern is a much smaller, more consolidated Wayfair-family storefront than Wayfair.com itself (already processed, se1.json): unlike Wayfair's 13 explicitly holiday-named nodes (Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, Valentine's Day, etc., each with its own breadcrumb), AllModern organizes everything under one generic 'Holiday' hub, split by PRODUCT TYPE rather than by holiday. Spot-checked product alt-text on each of the 10 child PLPs to assign a defensible 'category' label: Christmas Trees, Christmas Stockings + Holders, Ornaments + Tree Decor, Tree Skirts + Collars and Tree + Novelty Garlands are unambiguous Christmas-tree accessories (100% Christmas-tree-themed products sampled, no other holiday represented) and Garlands + Swag sampled as predominantly Christmas pine/fir garlands - all six labeled category 'Christmas'. Wreaths and Holiday Accents + Decor were confirmed via alt-text sampling to be genuinely MIXED across multiple occasions (Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Fall, Mother's Day, and explicit 'No Holiday'/'Everyday' items all co-listed on the same PLP with no holiday sub-filter splitting them into separate pages) - since the site itself does not separate these by holiday, they were labeled category 'Holiday' (matching the site's own umbrella name) rather than invented as 'Christmas'. Holiday Lighting sampled as generic string-lights/icicle-lights (some literally named 'Christmas Lights' but many just 'String Lights' with no holiday tie) also labeled 'Holiday'. Judaica (menorahs, Hanukkah candles, Sabbath candlesticks) is unambiguously Jewish-holiday product and was labeled category 'Hanukkah', sub_category 'Judaica' (matching the site's own PLP name), consistent with how Wayfair.com's own Judaica/menorah products were rolled into 'Hanukkah' in se1.json. Excluded: 'Holiday Sale' (638 Items, /holiday/cat/holiday-sale-c1877113.html) - checked and confirmed to be a cross-category discount filter over the same Holiday catalog (638 < 1,255 parent total, product mix identical to the main hub) rather than a distinct genuine category, per the sale/marketing-page exclusion rule. Also checked the seo-sb1 (903KB) and seo-sb2 (3 files, ~17MB total, ~3,341 combined keyword hits) sitemaps for any seasonal keyword (christmas/halloween/thanksgiving/easter/valentine/hanukkah/diwali/new-year/judaica) appearing OUTSIDE the /holiday/ path: found only deep attribute-filter permutation URLs such as .../kitchen-tabletop/sb1/halloween-mugs-teacups-c1875100-a123888~391234.html and .../kitchen-tabletop/sb2/earthenware-hanukkah-dinnerware-sets-place-settings-c1875080-a6055~17370-a123891~391415.html - these are non-seasonal base categories (Mugs & Teacups, Plates, Dinnerware Sets) filtered by a theme/color attribute, not genuine standalone PLPs the site's own nav presents as a category, so excluded per the 'category merely contains seasonal products' boundary rule. No Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Fourth of July, St. Patrick's Day, or Fall/Spring/Summer/Winter seasonal-decor top-level category exists anywhere in the site's own taxonomy (confirmed via the full 79-URL category sitemap and the 281-URL sb0 sitemap) - their absence is a genuine, confirmed finding, not an unchecked gap.
